name: iact_gampeg_ctao_lst4
label: gamma Peg (0.35 mas, B2 IV) on the four CTAO-North LSTs: diameter and linear limb darkening, Stage I against Stage II, one night
notes: The 103-179 m LST baselines reach x = pi B theta / lambda up to 2.2 at 425 nm (first null at 300 m): the diameter from the main lobe's curvature, the limb-darkening coefficient from the shape near the null, both with the zero-baseline normalization free.
Luce et al. (2024 talk): ~1 % on theta_UD for B < 3 with the four LSTs in 2.5 h.
